The subject is synthetic, with inspectable multiline summary and privacy sentinels.
No image is downloaded and no real account or user writing is included.

The record follows the [Bangumi archive subject fields](https://github.com/bangumi/Archive#readme),
with `images` in the [Bangumi subject API shape](https://github.com/bangumi/api/blob/master/open-api/v0.yaml).
The image URLs are inert fixture locations. The archive alone does not promise
image fields. The additional user posts, comments, reviews and account identifier
are hostile extensions, not claims about fields in the public archive.

The [Bangumi copyright policy](https://bgm.tv/about/copyright) distinguishes wiki
contributions, pre-existing copyrighted works and users' own writing. The task's
summary contract is CC-BY-SA-3.0 with attribution and ShareAlike. A summary is
creative content with its own rights, not an ODbL semantic fact. This record does
not identify a cover owner or grant a cover licence: retain a separate original
rights-holder credit/notice, source link and takedown eligibility without inventing
an owner or inheriting the metadata licence.

The import decision is [ADR-0036, imports and rights](https://github.com/rezics/rezics-next-discussion/blob/main/docs/adr/0036-content-in-postgresql-worker-uploads.md).
Behavioral references are `legacy-final:packages/conversion/src/bangumi.ts` and
`legacy-final:packages/conversion/src/errors.ts`: record identity/type validation
and pure conversion inform these tests. Their grain, slot and provider output
protocols are obsolete and are not part of this specification.
